_help: Copy of this file lives at profile/profile.json (gitignored). Every value here is typed into real application forms, so it must be true. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

location._help: Where you live now. Used for city/state/zip/address fields.

education._school_help: If your school is often missing from dropdowns, set school_fallback to the option forms use instead (usually 'Other').

work_auth._help: Answer truthfully. requires_sponsorship covers 'now or in the future'. visa_status is free text shown where forms ask (e.g. 'US Citizen', 'Permanent Resident', 'F-1 student, eligible for CPT/OPT').

eeo._help: Voluntary self-identification. Leave the decline values unless you want to answer. Greenhouse matches option text, so keep these close to the standard wording.
eeo.disability: I do not want to answer

preferences.start_date: As soon as possible / open to discussion

resume._help: Path relative to the repo root. One PDF used for every application unless you tailor per role.

search._help: Filters for the pollers. A title must contain one level keyword AND one role keyword, and none of the exclude keywords.
